# S83 Trust-mark rights evidence

**Status: NOT_ASSESSED.** No permission record in the S83 asset ledger authorizes the Trust marks in an AGMM review copy, public master, site or post. Do not imply Trust endorsement.

## Official material found

- Walsall Together, *Communications and Brand Style Guide* (October 2020): [official PDF](https://www.walsallhealthcare.nhs.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Communications-and-Brand-Style-Guide-October-2020.pdf). It directs users seeking advice on applying that brand/logo to `walsall.together@walsallhealthcare.nhs.uk`. The guide concerns Walsall Together branding; it does not grant AGMM permission to reproduce Walsall Healthcare NHS Trust's corporate mark.
- The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust, OP01 public policy: [official PDF](https://www.royalwolverhampton.nhs.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/18753_OP_01_PUBLIC_Policy_Printable_Version.pdf). Its logo section addresses BCPS use: external logos require written permission from the owner and the BCPS Chief Medical Officer, with Owner Trust logo use requiring approval in that context. This is not a grant of permission to AGMM or a general Trust mark licence.

These sources are recorded as cautionary guidance only. Neither is permission for this S83 use. The asset ledger remains `NOT_ASSESSED`; no public-use rights, endorsement, or creator consent are inferred.

## Temporary review artifact limit

The source workflow will place captured marks and stills in the existing pinned GitHub Actions artifact with one-day retention, never in a public Git branch. The repository is public. GitHub's [artifact REST documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/artifacts) says public resources can be accessed without authentication, so this artifact is time-bounded but is **not** an authenticated/private access boundary. Treat its payload as potentially publicly retrievable during its retention window. Root must account for that before dispatch; these receipts do not clear the raw marks.
